name: Alps Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1972, Alps Industries Ltd is in the textile business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AIL manufactures home textile products, including bedding, window dressings, decorative pillows and accents, table linen, and kitchen linen. These products are made from vegetable-dyed fabrics, organic cotton, and recycled cotton fabrics.
